overview: Wilderness Lodge is a Deluxe resort inspired by grand national park lodges, with a towering timber lobby and a geyser by the lake. It's on Bay Lake with a boat to Magic Kingdom.
suits: Families and couples who want a cozy, rustic Deluxe resort at a lower price than the monorail hotels.
rooms: Standard rooms sleep four, and many have balconies overlooking the courtyard or the woods.
pools: Copper Creek Springs Pool is fed by a creek that starts in the lobby, with a waterslide nearby.
dining: Whispering Canyon Cafe is known for its playful servers, and Story Book Dining at Artist Point is a character dinner. Geyser Point Bar & Grill sits on the lake.
pros: Usually cheaper than the monorail Deluxe resorts
cons: Buses to every park except Magic Kingdom
Smaller rooms than some Deluxe resorts
Boat service can pause in bad weather
tips: Watch the Fire Rock Geyser erupt by the lake.
Use the walking path to Fort Wilderness for a change of scenery.
bestFor: Families and couples who want a cozy Deluxe stay.
